title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Server Ping Work Item
summary: Add a server-side tunnel context helper that writes ping control frames while preserving the accepted RFC 9220 tunnel for pong and later data messages.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext.PingAsync` to write unmasked server ping frames through the accepted tunnel.
- Add a loopback HTTP/3 server test that receives a server ping, sends a masked pong with the same payload, sends a later text message, and verifies the tunnel remains usable for the handler response.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket server-ping test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The accepted tunnel context can now send explicit server ping frames and preserve the tunnel for pong and later data.
